shadow_trades.reasoning_summary: I currently have equal amounts (1 each) of B, A, and C. Trading away my only A for another B would give me 2 B, 0 A, 1 C, which reduces variety and makes my bundle less balanced. Since I value variety, this trade would decrease my utility.
This trade would leave me with 0 B and 2 A, moving from an even 1-1-1 distribution to an uneven one. Since I value variety, this would decrease my utility rather than improve it.

Giving up my only B (going to 0) to get a 3rd A would create imbalance (0,3,1), which is worse for variety-preference than current (1,1,1). I'd rather keep B and seek a trade that diversifies rather than concentrates.
This trade would leave me with B:2, A:1, C:0, making my bundle less balanced (I'd have zero of C). Since I value variety, going from 1 each to having none of C is a downgrade, not an improvement.

Trading away my only B for another C would leave me with 0 B, 1 A, 2 C - reducing variety and making my bundle less balanced. Since I value variety, this trade decreases my utility rather than increasing it.

Trading away my only B (going to 0) to get a second C would leave me with 0 B, 1 A, 3 C - a highly imbalanced bundle. Since I value variety, this reduces utility rather than improving it. I'd rather keep at least 1 of each good.
